card.name: Antibiotic colitis warning wording
card.fires_on: Words inside the stock warning that antibacterial treatment alters the normal flora of the colon, mostly 'the' just before 'normal flora' or 'colon'. It also fires on a few other word slots in memorized label lists, such as the comma after paresthesias.

modes.label: Normal flora sentence
modes.description: Linking words inside 'alters the normal flora of the colon' in the C. difficile colitis warning.
modes.example: Treatment with antibacterial agents alters<< the>> normal flora of the colon leading to over

modes.label: Other label lists
modes.description: Commas or word starts inside fixed adverse-reaction or infection lists.
modes.example: axons resulting in paresthesias<<,>> hypoesthesias, dysesthes

card.writes: The promoted tokens are odd name-like pieces, so there is no clear output effect beyond weak noise.
card.plain: It lights up on familiar wording in antibiotic labels about colitis and gut bacteria being disturbed.
